+import pytest

+

+    def __init__(self):

+

+
+    def advance(self, seconds):

+

+    c = Cache(ttl=10, clock=clock)

+    assert "a" not in c

+    clock = FakeClock()

+

+    c = Cache(clock=clock)

+import pytest

+

+    sleeps = []
+    calls = []
+

+    def flaky():
+        calls.append(1)
+        if len(calls) < 2:

+        return "ok"
+

+

+        raise TypeError("nope")

+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from todo import cli
+
+
+def write_tasks(tmp_path, items):
+    p = tmp_path / "todo.json"
+    p.write_text(json.dumps(items))
+    return str(p)
+
+
+ITEMS = [
+    {"id": 1, "title": "ship it", "done": True},
+    {"id": 2, "title": "write docs", "due": "2026-03-01"},
+    {"id": 3, "title": "triage"},
+]
+
+
+def test_list_json(tmp_path, capsys):
+    path = write_tasks(tmp_path, ITEMS)
+    assert cli.main(["--file", path, "list", "--format", "json"]) == 0
+    assert json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out) == [
+        {"id": 2, "title": "write docs", "done": False, "due": "2026-03-01"},
+        {"id": 3, "title": "triage", "done": False, "due": None},
+        {"id": 1, "title": "ship it", "done": True, "due": None},
+    ]
+
+
+def test_list_json_empty(tmp_path, capsys):
+    assert cli.main(["--file", str(tmp_path / "none.json"), "list", "--format", "json"]) == 0
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "[]"
+
+
+def test_list_done_filter(tmp_path, capsys):
+    path = write_tasks(tmp_path, ITEMS)
+    assert cli.main(["--file", path, "list", "--done"]) == 0
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines() == ["[x] 1: ship it"]
+
+
+def test_list_pending_filter_json(tmp_path, capsys):
+    path = write_tasks(tmp_path, ITEMS)
+    assert cli.main(["--file", path, "list", "--pending", "--format", "json"]) == 0
+    assert [t["id"] for t in json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)] == [2, 3]
+
+
+def test_done_and_pending_is_usage_error(tmp_path):
+    path = write_tasks(tmp_path, ITEMS)
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc:
+        cli.main(["--file", path, "list", "--done", "--pending"])
+    assert exc.value.code == 2
